name: search-reporting
description: Explain Google Search Console AI impressions and why chart and page totals differ. Use when you need a client explanation, reportable growth figures or a reconciliation of several supplied exports and original screen values. Works from pasted report text, CSV files, filter labels and file or cell locations. Produces a readable client table and, when requested, a reusable source ledger and calculation record. Keeps dedicated AI reporting separate from ordinary Web comparisons. Not for SEO content writing, ranking recommendations, account monitoring or changing Search Console settings.
